changesAppRestart: Takes effect after restarting the app
webhookDescription: When a track reaches the set percentage, the app sends its data to the webhook URL
enableRichPresence: Show the track in Discord status
useArtistInStatusLine: Artist name in the status line instead of the app name
richPresencePreviewDescription: Shows right here how the status looks in Discord
trackParserDescription: Separates the artist from the title when both are written in one line
richPresencePreviewTitle: This is how Discord shows the status
incognitoOn: Incognito: Discord doesn’t see what’s playing
pageLoadFailed: Couldn’t load SoundCloud. The client will retry when the connection is back, or press Ctrl+R.
googleSignInRejected: Google blocked sign-in in the app window. Close it and try again, or sign in with email: “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page sets a password for your Google account
browserLoginMessage: Google does not allow sign-in inside embedded browsers. Sign in to SoundCloud in your regular browser and the client will pick up the session.
browserLoginDetail:
1. Click “Open SoundCloud” and sign in there with Google.
2. Install the Cookie-Editor extension (“Extension”), open it on soundcloud.com and click Export → JSON: everything is copied to the clipboard.
3. Come back here and click “Sign in from clipboard”.

The session stays on this computer and is not sent anywhere.
browserLoginBadEmpty: The clipboard is empty. Copy the session in your browser (Cookie-Editor: Export → JSON) and click “Sign in from clipboard” again.
browserLoginBadFormat: The clipboard does not look like a SoundCloud session. You need the JSON from Cookie-Editor (Export → JSON) or the oauth_token value.
browserLoginBadNoToken: The copied data has no oauth_token cookie. Sign in to SoundCloud in your browser and export the cookies from soundcloud.com.
browserLoginBadValue: The token looks damaged or truncated. Copy the session again.
browserLoginNoRefresh: Only the access token was imported: it lasts a day. To stay signed in, export the cookies with Cookie-Editor (Export → JSON).
shortLinkFailed: Couldn’t open the link: SoundCloud didn’t find it or there’s no connection
downloadFailed: Couldn’t download the track: SoundCloud didn’t provide the file or there’s no connection
downloadBusy: Another download is in progress: wait until it finishes
fullTrackBlocked: Full tracks from YouTube aren’t loading: YouTube asks to sign in again. Refresh yt-cookies.txt in the data folder (or switch VPN server); previews play meanwhile
youtubeLoginNotify: YouTube asks to sign in, so previews are playing. Click to connect YouTube
youtubeLoginMessage: Connect YouTube to play full tracks instead of 30-second previews
youtubeLoginDetail:
1. “Open YouTube”: sign in to your account in your browser. A private window keeps the session alive longer.
2. In the Cookie-Editor extension press Export → JSON (no extension? use the button below).
3. Close the private window and press “Paste from clipboard”.

The client keeps only youtube.com and google.com cookies, stored on this computer.
youtubeLoginNoLogin: The clipboard has YouTube cookies without a signed-in account. Sign in to YouTube and export again
youtubeLoginBadFormat: The clipboard doesn’t contain YouTube cookies. In Cookie-Editor on youtube.com press Export → JSON
youtubeLoginDone: YouTube connected: full tracks are searched again
playerCrashed: The player stopped with an error. The client will restart it in a minute, or press Ctrl+R.
pageGaveUp: SoundCloud didn’t load after several attempts. Open the client and press Ctrl+R.
proxyPasswordUnreadable: Couldn’t read the proxy password. Enter it again.
adBlockFailed: The ad blocker didn’t load, ads may show up
headerHistoryRecap: History, Ctrl+H. Your weekly recap is ready
updateScreenInstalling: Installing. The app will reopen in a few seconds
updateScreenFailed: Couldn’t update. Check your connection and try again
updateScreenReleased: Version {v} is out. The portable version doesn’t install it by itself: download it from the release page
